cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import base64, time, struct, re, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import kit
objs=[('x%d'%i, (i%251).to_bytes(1+(i%4),'little')) for i in range(1000)]
payload = base64.b64decode(kit.encode(objs))
up=struct.unpack_from
NAME=re.compile(rb'x(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)\Z')
def header(buffer):
    if buffer[:5]!=b'KTEST': raise ValueError
    v,=up('>I',buffer,5)
    if v!=3: raise ValueError
    argc,=up('>I',buffer,9); o=13
    for _ in range(argc):
        n,=up('>I',buffer,o)
        if n>256: raise ValueError
        o+=4+n
    o+=8
    count,=up('>I',buffer,o)
    return o+4, count
def A(buffer):  # str keys + regex validation
    o,count=header(buffer); out={}; L=len(buffer)
    for _ in range(count):
        n,=up('>I',buffer,o); o+=4; e=o+n
        raw=buffer[o:e]; o=e
        if not NAME.match(raw): raise ValueError('name')
        n,=up('>I',buffer,o); o+=4; e=o+n
        out[raw.decode('ascii')]=buffer[o:e]; o=e
    if offset_end(o,L): pass
    if o!=L: raise ValueError('trailing')
    if len(out)!=count: raise ValueError('dup')
    return out
def offset_end(o,L): return False
def B(buffer):  # bytes keys, no validation
    o,count=header(buffer); out={}; L=len(buffer)
    for _ in range(count):
        n,=up('>I',buffer,o); o+=4; e=o+n
        name=buffer[o:e]; o=e
        n,=up('>I',buffer,o); o+=4; e=o+n
        out[name]=buffer[o:e]; o=e
    if o!=L: raise ValueError('trailing')
    if len(out)!=count: raise ValueError('dup')
    return out
def C(buffer):  # bytes keys + isdigit validation
    o,count=header(buffer); out={}; L=len(buffer)
    for _ in range(count):
        n,=up('>I',buffer,o); o+=4; e=o+n
        raw=buffer[o:e]; o=e
        digits=raw[1:]
        if raw[0:1]!=b'x' or not digits.isdigit() or (len(digits)>1 and digits[0]==48): raise ValueError('name')
        n,=up('>I',buffer,o); o+=4; e=o+n
        out[raw]=buffer[o:e]; o=e
    if o!=L: raise ValueError('trailing')
    if len(out)!=count: raise ValueError('dup')
    return out
for name,fn in [('A str+regex',A),('B bytes',B),('C bytes+isdigit',C)]:
    t=time.time()
    for _ in range(300): fn(payload)
    print('%-16s %.3f ms'%(name,(time.time()-t)/300*1000))
print(A(payload)=={k:v for k,v in C(payload).items()} if False else 'ok')
r1=A(payload); r2=C(payload)
print(all(r1[k.decode()]==v for k,v in r2.items()), len(r1), len(r2))
PYEOF
